notes: §1985:VI.6.25.4 GR9: "Before each move of a character to the data item referenced by identifier-3, if the value associated with the data item referenced by identifier-4 is either less than one or exceeds the number of character positions in the data item referenced by identifier-3, no (further) data is transferred to the data item referenced by identifier-3, and the NOT ON OVERFLOW phrase, if specified, is ignored and control is transferred to the end of the STRING statement or, if the ON OVERFLOW phrase is specified, to imperative-statement-1." CobolStringOps.StringTransfer tests the pointer before each character it moves (below 1 or above the receiver's length), sets the overflow flag and stops, and a set flag makes every later sending operand's call return at once; EmitString issues one call per sending operand and stores the pointer back only when it moved. StringEmitter.EmitOverflow then runs the ON OVERFLOW statements when the flag is set and the NOT ON OVERFLOW statements only when it is clear, so with overflow and no ON phrase control falls to the end of the statement. The 1985 edition differs from 2023 only in the EC-OVERFLOW-STRING raise, which EcEmitter.EnabledHere suppresses unless a TURN directive enabled checking, and 1985 has no such directive. The witness overflows once mid-transfer and once with a zero pointer, both with the two phrases written. Probed further at --std 85: an exact fit and a move into the last position (no overflow), overflow in the second of three operands with only NOT ON OVERFLOW written (nothing runs, the third operand is not transferred), no phrase at all, a negative pointer, a zero pointer with no character to move (no test, no overflow), and a GO TO in the ON OVERFLOW statements all behave as the rule states.

next.reason: 1985: "the NOT ON OVERFLOW phrase, if specified, is ignored and control is transferred to the end of the STRING statement"; 2023: "b) The EC-OVERFLOW-STRING exception condition is set to exist. ... d) If the ON OVERFLOW phrase is not specified, execution continues as specified in 14.6.13.1.4". The overflow test and ON OVERFLOW flow are the same, but 2023 raises EC-OVERFLOW-STRING. Without ON OVERFLOW, nonfatal exception processing replaces the plain transfer to the end of STRING.
